name: Redland City
snapshotStatus: Reviewed static snapshot. Different sources have different reference dates.

censusStatus.note: 2026 results are not available in this snapshot. A 2027 product preview may use reshaped 2021 data and must not be labelled 2026 Census results.

boundaryNotes: Redland City council, its ten electoral divisions, state districts and federal divisions are different geographies.
The 2017 state boundaries remain in use for current representation and any by-election until the October 2028 state general election; new boundaries were set in June 2026.
Current state districts relevant to the council include Capalaba, Oodgeroo, Redlands and Springwood. Exact addresses must be checked with ECQ.
No calculated area, resident or elector overlap percentage is asserted. Coastal water boundaries, land area, ABS mesh-block approximations and different editions can produce different totals.
Electoral boundaries do not define or settle Country, Traditional Owner rights or cultural authority.

changeLog.change: Initial Redland local example: retained authentic map PDFs, PNG renditions, 2025 ERP and explicitly dated 2021 Census indicators. No by-election announcement or candidate intention inferred.

Added the authentic ECQ 2019 final council division map, retrieved through a public browser download after direct downloads were blocked. Also added Wikimedia's authentic ShapingSEQ 2023 regional map, a declared rectangular detail and clearly historical locator references. Historical enrolment labels remain explicitly dated.

refreshTriggers.trigger: ABS Regional population release or revision
refreshTriggers.action: Recheck the release schedule; replace ERP and matching revised prior-year values together. Record the release and reference dates.
Replace indicators only when matching geography and definitions are released. Keep historical values and do not relabel old prices as current.

refreshTriggers.trigger: ECQ or AEC redistribution, gazette or boundary correction
refreshTriggers.action: Separate gazetted future boundaries from boundaries used by current representatives and any by-election. Retain original map, edition, credits and changed-date record.
Check the official ECQ event and current law before updating any status, countdown or nomination record.
